metadata.flags: -std=c11 -O2 -fno-fast-math -ffp-contract=off; no LTO; default target; no stripping
metadata.memory_method: sum of process-tree RSS/working sets sampled every 1ms, including Python launcher children; maximum observed sum is a lower bound; null if unobserved
metadata.timing_method: internal monotonic wall clock for kernel; external perf_counter includes setup/output/cleanup and monitoring; separate empty-process startup

method: Randomized paired uninstrumented process runs; internal allocation-inclusive workload and setup clocks. Separate counters/GC event hooks and OS time peak-RSS runs. Explicit-domain programs are source variants, not automatic transformations. GC timings are collection events/stop-world intervals, not workload latency.
limitations: RSS and final collector capacity include runtime/startup
Heap minus free is occupied capacity, not exact reachable bytes
Collector thread CPU excludes other threads and parallel marking
GC samples capped at 4096; counts expose truncation
